findings.status: fixed; 270 screen cases and three print modes passed
findings.evidence: In forced-light mode with a dark site theme, canvas axes kept #cbd8e8 on white (1.4456:1). In forced-dark mode with a light theme, #465a70 remained on black (2.9569:1). CSS foreground had correctly switched; canvas pixels had not.

findings.status: fixed; 564 normal and 564 forced-color article print layouts passed

findings.status: fixed; short-block focus retained and cleanup after blur passed
findings.evidence: At desktop width the short process/PID code block selected the correct text, but its layout observer removed tabindex and blurred the manual-copy target. The expanded clipboard check failed with focused=false, exact=true.
findings.change: Keep tabindex while the pre is focused; schedule cleanup after blur.

findings.status: fixed; 36 layout cases, five modifier cases, legacy anchor and fragment history passed
findings.evidence: Holding the TOC frame, selecting a chapter and then pressing Tab moved focus to the permalink; flushing the old frame moved it back to H2. Chapter navigation is now synchronous and leaves modifier clicks to the browser.

findings.status: fixed; 18 targeted cases passed; broader checks running
